assumptions: token counts: a regex-piece model fitted to Anthropic billed totals; the same counts are priced under OpenAI/Gemini rules (their tokenizers differ)
request times: uniform spacing over the task's wall time (harness has no per-step timestamps)
Gemini implicit cache: 300 s life and hit probability 1.0 (undocumented: an upper bound on its caching); explicit-cache creation at the standard input rate
pure-cost columns replay the SAME trajectory; behaviour (extra steps) enters only through the fitted re-run penalty band
cost: $0: offline replay, no model or API calls

band.source: low = no behaviour change; mid/high = distil's paired estimate and its upper 95% bound; stress = selective-context (irrecoverable deletion)
band.unit: extra agent steps per 1k tokens of information removed
